standard_prerequisites.name: Ordinal addition recursion equations
standard_prerequisites.use: Supplies the successor step (alpha+beta)+1 = alpha+(beta+1) shape and the limit supremum characterisation used in all three induction cases.

core_obligations: Statement (lines 538-551, clause 3): alpha + (beta + gamma) = (alpha + beta) + gamma for ordinals.
Induction on gamma (proof lines 553-578): gamma = 0 collapses both sides to alpha + beta;
successor case chains the recursion equation three times through the induction hypothesis;
limit case moves the supremum through addition using the limit characterisation of the recursion lemma.
proof_roadmap: Handle gamma = 0 by the base recursion equation.
Chain the successor case through three applications of the recursion lemma.
Move supstrict through addition in the limit case.
difficulty_reason: Associativity of ordinal addition (statement 538-551 clause 3, proof 553-578): the author proves exactly this clause by a complete three-case transfinite induction; the sibling clauses are explicitly left as exercise and are rejected, not counted. H3.
